data.question_quote: Are you making any significant changes in that space? And specifically on mortgage tokenisation, when do you expect that to be a commercial reality for Barclays? And do you think that, that will come with higher spreads?
data.answer_quote: Okay. So I think it's too early to talk about tokenisation and what that might do within mortgages.
